name: BSP_SceneDatabase_ClassIdToName
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet scene_entity_factory, read-only analysis. __thiscall(SceneDatabase*, int classId), RET 4. Adds 0x34 to ECX itself, iterates the class map with 00466BB0/00466C00, matches when *(node+8) (the descriptor's first dword) equals the id and returns node+4, the class name. Returns 0 when no row matches and the global at 00E18560 when a matched row has a null name pointer, which 004EE250 never produces. NOT a class-id to factory map, contrary to docs/SCENE_FILE_READER.md.

name: BSP_SceneClassMap_FindNode
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet scene_entity_factory, read-only analysis. __thiscall(map, NativeString* key, int* outHash). Hashes the key with 00468A90, writes the hash to *outHash, walks the bucket chain at map+8+hash*4 comparing the stored length then the string with 00438E10 (case-insensitive), returns the node or 0. Its caller 0046CF40 reads the class descriptor as *(node+8) with no null check, so an unregistered class token faults.

name: BSP_SceneDatabase_ClassNameToId

name: BSP_NativeString_Substring
evidence: Substring copy; normal name call uses start0,count=final dot index. No case transformation. General malformed/overflow semantics not reimplemented. Original ABI: ECX source native string; stack output string,start,count; EAX output; RET0C. Evidence: docs/MATERIAL_PASS_COMPILER.md; reports/material_pass_compiler_audit.json. Descriptive symbol is a hypothesis. Host interfaces are not native ABI or game validation.

name: BSP_SceneDatabase_ClearPendingReferences
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(void), RET 0, on the {count, head, tail} list at scene database +14Ch. Empties the list: each node with a non-null [node+8] runs 00469010 then frees that block, otherwise it is unlinked; then the node itself is freed and the count decremented. Ghidra shows a single-node pop because the fall-through after the _free call at 00bf65ac is dropped by a no-return annotation; the listing gaps 0046aa17..0046aa21 and 0046aa52..0046aa5c decode to "add esp,4 / mov [esi+8],0" and "add esp,4 / cmp [edi],0 / jne 0x46aa00", the loop back edge. name: BSP_SceneDatabase_LoadSceneFile
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol, and provisional: identified from its literals and its three call sites, the 0x1062-byte body was not read. Packet mission_scene_load, read-only analysis. __thiscall(this=[00e18680], const char* scenePath, 0, char, void* sceneRecord, const char* override, char); the 004dfb70 call site at 004e01d7 passes ([game+5FCh]+910h, 0, 0, game+5FCh, game+604h, 0) and 004d4df0 makes the other two passes with the last-but-three and last arguments toggled. 24 string immediates including SceneBrowserGroups, groups, entity, LandVehicle, LandFort, CommandBuilding, VehicleClass, traffic and g_Terrain.ga_StaticShadowShotSize, in segment 6 whose keywords are groupname, scenebrowsergroups, browsergroup, spawnpoint. Three callers: 004d4df0, 004dfb70, 004e1d70. docs/MISSION_SCENE_LOAD.md. | Body read for packet scene_file_reader. __thiscall, RET 0x18: (this=[00e18680], const char* scenePath, void* a2, char instantiate, void* sceneRecord, const char* overrideName, char registration). The .scn file is plain text; the tokenizer 008d9cf0 is constructed with the delimiter set ";{}=:(,)" (00ce4f40). Three passes selected by arguments 3 and 6: (0,0) header only, the entity loop skipped at 0046e9d5; (0,1) header plus entities in registration mode, stopping at the first traffic/groups/SceneBrowserGroups; (1,0) header, full entity construction, all four tail blocks, then 0046aab0. Top-level dispatch: header 00ce5994 -> 00469bf0, entity 00ce5818 -> 0046cf40, traffic 00ce5890 -> 009514b0 (or 0095ca10 on pass 2), groups 00ce55e4 -> 00467e10, SceneBrowserGroups 00ce56a4 -> 00469e40. Prologue: 0046a9f0 on this+14Ch, the path split on the last "." into this+13Ch/+140h and this+144h/+148h, then the Weathers walk of SCRIPTS\datatables\Weather.lua (00ce59dc) which, with no override name, writes the four g_Terrain.* console variables g_StaticShadowTexture, ga_StaticShadowShotOffsetX, ga_StaticShadowShotOffsetZ and ga_StaticShadowShotSize. All 259 installed .scn files parse under the recovered grammar. See docs/SCENE_FILE_READER.md.
